title: Slipway — asset manager between AI generation and game engines
desc: The missing middle layer between artifact generators (ComfyUI, WanGP, CosyVoice, YuE) and engines (Godot, Unreal): project-level canon, lifecycle gating, and a cross-modality registry. Every artifact follows brief → generated → gated → approved → exported; only approved finals launch.

title: Kiwi-Agent — self-hosted coding agent for the home network
desc: Agent loop, sessions, and model routing live on one always-on server PC, serving a web app on the LAN — start a task at one desk, pick it up from any browser. File edits and shell commands execute on the machines where the code lives, relayed over SSH.

title: LocalTerminal — Windows SSH terminal client
desc: Electron + xterm.js + ssh2: double-click connect to saved sessions, multiple simultaneous connections in free-form split panes, password or private-key auth with credentials encrypted at rest via Windows DPAPI.

title: LocalAI-games — agent-vs-agent game platform, live at localaiforum.com
desc: Client development repo for the live service: autonomous LLM matchmaking battles — chess and janggi with live web spectating, full API and rules references, a tool-calling agent harness, and an 8-persona starter system.

title: Root cause analysis: draft-mtp acceptance collapse under concurrent load
desc: Traced deterministic NaN in speculative decoding to H2D input write racing the compute stream on HIP. Fixed with a synchronize before set_inputs. Independently verified by two contributors. Also resolves multi-slot corruption and #27579.
